explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/299 with the negative answer, which follows from Bloom's theorem since bounded gaps give positive density. There is no strictly increasing positive sequence with a_{i+1} - a_i = O(1) such that no finite subsum of 1/a_i equals 1. The index-set encoding of 'finite sum' is correct, because strict monotonicity makes indices and values correspond. Lean 3 formalisation exists.
